option_relations.rationale: Lennox-Gastaut syndrome is a specific epileptic encephalopathy, but the vignette points to a genetic cause (CHD2 variant) which is more specific than Lennox-Gastaut syndrome.
Epileptic encephalopathy, early infantile type is a broader category that includes CHD2-related epileptic encephalopathy.
Developmental and Epileptic Encephalopathy-94 (DEE-94) caused by pathogenic CHD2 gene variant is a specific and accurate description of CHD2-related epileptic encephalopathy, making it equivalent.
CHD2-related neurodevelopmental disorder (CHD2 encephalopathy) is another name for CHD2-related epileptic encephalopathy, making it equivalent.
